subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: Should bundled Telegram support include Telegram Business personal-DM handling now, and what account-scoped business_connection_id authority model should it use?
rationale: The feature is aligned with major-channel support, but it changes personal-DM access and outbound send authority; automation should not choose the security/product boundary after the prior implementation was closed for those exact concerns.

options.title: Approve bounded Telegram Business support
options.body: Implement it in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable Business connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Defer until owner design is written
options.body: Keep this tracker open but require a short maintainer design note for access control, persistence, and outbound authority before any new PR is accepted.

options.title: Do not support in bundled Telegram
options.body: Close the direction and ask users to keep using external relay/proxy approaches until a plugin/API seam is explicitly approved.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Telegram Business support
recommendation.body: Implement it in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable Business connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc closed the prior same-repo implementation with a current-owner-direction note and has recent Telegram seam history.
